title: Jiaqing's Website
text:
Research Experience
Graduate Research Assistant | Oklahoma State University | June 2023 – Present

High-Throughput Multi-Omics: Analyze 16S rRNA (QIIME2 | phyloseq | ANCOM-BC2), RNA-seq (fastp | STAR | TSEM | DESeq2 | clusterProfiler), metagenomic (Bowtie | Samtools | Diamond | MaxBin2 | MetaBAT2 | CONCOCT | CheckM) and nanopore (dorado | emu | self-developed pipeline) datasets to identify biomarkers and biological pathways.

Pipeline Development: Explore and apply updated analytical methods for microbiota data, ensuring high performance computational workflows and reproducibility.

Translational Insights: Characterized the dynamic interplay between host and microbial communities during pathogen challenge; identified specific intestinal commensals that mitigate infection severity, supporting the development of microbe-based disease intervention strategies.

Project Leadership & Collaboration: Independently designed and led computational analyses, interpreting multiomics data, and translating findings into mechanistic biological stories.

Mentorship: Trained and mentored junior lab members in bioinformatics workflows, R programming, and high performance computing (HPC).

title: Jiaqing's Website
text:
Skills
Bioinformatic & Computational Skills

Computational Biology: Extensive experience in analyzing nanopore data, shotgun metagenomics, 16S rRNA gene profiling, and transcriptomics (RNA-Seq). Experienced in genome assembly, comparative genomics, profiling, and network metabolic reconstruction.

Programming: Proficient in R and experienced in Python for advanced data wrangling, statistical modeling, and custom data visualization. Experienced in SQL for efficient data extraction and management.

Statistics: Adept at selecting and applying appropriate statistical frameworks based on complex data structures. Experienced in time series data analysis for prediction and developing machine learning models (Ridge and LASSO Regression, High Dimensional Regression, Principal Component Analysis, Random Forest) for dimensionality reduction, feature selection, and predictive analytics.

High-Performance Computing & Infrastructure: Proficient in Linux/Bash/Shell scripting for managing large-scale sequencing datasets in high-performance environments, and experienced in building complex, reproducible bioinformatic analytical environments using Conda | Mamba | Docker | Nextflow.

Molecular Biology Skills

Nucleic Acid Isolation: Proficient in high-quality DNA isolation and purification.

Bacterial Culture Methods: Experienced in standard bacterial culturing techniques, including media preparation aseptic handling, and colony isolation.
